query:
The Ridge and Trail Collective operates with a norm that everyone carries a full personal first aid kit and a foil emergency blanket on every outing. Does this apply to all members equally? If not, who has a different pattern and what does the conversation show?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Kwame
C. Saoirse
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Kwame, episodic, t14 @2025-11-09T15:40:00) I did read the route sheet! I just... didn't action it 😩 that's the problem. I read it and I still left without checking the bag. that's on me completely. I'm putting a kit checklist on my phone as a reminder before every outing. no more borrowing people's gear, it's not fair 🙏
[2] (about=Kwame, episodic, t14 @2025-11-09T15:34:00) ok everyone I owe Nadia a huge apology 😬 I showed up today without my waterproofs AGAIN on a rain-forecast day and had to borrow her emergency layer. Nadia I am so sorry. my bad my bad. I felt genuinely terrible about it the entire walk. I'm putting the waterproofs in my bag tonight and they are not coming out.
agent_answer:
The applicable norm is not followed equally by all members — the person with a different pattern is **B. Kwame**.

The conversation shows Kwame twice admitting he showed up without his own gear: he left without checking his bag (excerpt [1]) and, on a rain-forecast day, he arrived without his waterproofs "AGAIN" and had to borrow Nadia's emergency layer (excerpt [2]). He acknowledges this is completely on him, apologizes to Nadia, and says he will set a kit checklist and keep his gear packed from now on, swearing off borrowing other people's gear.

So Kwame is the one who deviates from the carry-your-own-gear norm, while Nadia is the one who had to lend him her gear.

query:
The group has an informal rule that no one posts Strava or social media content that reveals a route before the group has completed it. Does this hold for every member, and what in the conversation points to who might not follow it consistently?

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Tomas
C. Kwame
D. Elena
context:
[1] (about=Elena, episodic, t13 @2025-11-09T15:30:00) right so Marcus absolutely destroyed the south spur timed segment today -- I had 8:43 and he came in at 8:21. that is an actual route PR for that section 😤 not sulking, just noting it for the record 👀
[2] (about=Elena, episodic, t16 @2025-11-16T15:06:00) I know that. Still counts 😄 there's a second timed segment on the lower return path -- I want to add that to the standard route sheet for next time. Gives us two data points.
agent_answer:
No — the conversation does **not** show the rule holding for every member. The only person with evidence of possibly not following it is **Elena (D)**.

Elena posts/notes Strava-style segment details: she references the “south spur timed segment,” her time (8:43) versus Marcus’s (8:21), calls it a “route PR for that section,” and then says she wants to add another timed segment on the “lower return path” to the standard route sheet — which reveals route information.

- **Marcus** is only mentioned as having the PR; he isn’t shown posting anything.
- **Tomas** and **Kwame** have no record in the conversation at all.

So the answer is **D. Elena**.
